author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm still single.

jyutping: ngo5 zung6 hai6 daan1 san1。
text: 我仲係單身。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Do you think you can live on a dollar a day in America?

jyutping: nei5 gok3 dak1 nei5 hai2 mei5 gwok3 mui5 jat6 zing6 hai6 jung6 jat1 mei5 gam1 saang1 m4 saang1 wut6 dou3？
text: 你覺得你喺美國每日淨係用一美金生唔生活到？

author: nickyeow

english.text: He went out of the room without being noticed by anyone.

jyutping: keoi5 zing6 gai1 gai1 gam2 haang4 ceot1 zo2 gaan1 fong4，mou5 jan4 faat3 jin6 dou3 keoi5。
text: 佢靜雞雞噉行出咗間房，冇人發現到佢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: This is the second time I've flown.

jyutping: gam1 ci3 hai6 ngo5 dai6 ji6 ci3 daap3 fei1 gei1。
text: 今次係我第二次搭飛機。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I want you to meet my parents.

jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 nei5 gin3 haa5 ngo5 aa3 baa4 aa3 maa1。
text: 我想你見吓我阿爸阿媽。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Do you know how many people starve to death in the world annually?

jyutping: nei5 zi1 m4 zi1 cyun4 sai3 gaai3 mui5 nin4 jau5 gei2 do1 jan4 ngo6 sei2 aa3？
text: 你知唔知全世界每年有幾多人餓死呀？

english.text: What do you do after dinner?

jyutping: nei5 sik6 jyun4 maan5 faan6 tung1 soeng4 zou6 mat1 je5？

english.text: It's not us who did it.

jyutping: m4 hai6 ngo5 dei6 zou6 gaa3。
text: 唔係我哋做㗎。

author: kaenif

english.text: I'm sorry, but the only thing I know how to say in this beautiful language is this sentence.

jyutping: deoi3 m4 zyu6 aa3，bat1 gwo3 ngo5 zing6 hai6 sik1 jung6 ni1 zung2 gam3 leng3 ge3 jyu5 jin4 gong2 jat1 geoi3 je5 zaa3。
text: 對唔住呀，不過我淨係識用呢種咁靚嘅語言講一句嘢咋。

english.text: I'm used to working all night.

jyutping: ngo5 gwaan3 zo2 tung1 deng2 zou6 je5。

english.text: I know how to get there.

jyutping: ngo5 sik1 heoi3 go2 dou6。

english.text: Tom can swim much faster than I can.

jyutping: aa3 Tom jau4 seoi2 faai3 gwo3 ngo5 hou2 do1。
text: 阿Tom游水快過我好多。

author: nickyeow

english.text: There's no chair to sit upon.

english.text: He asked me if I was busy.
He asked me whether I was busy.

jyutping: keoi5 man6 ngo5 hai6 mai6 hou2 mong4。
text: 佢問我係咪好忙。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The house wasn't particularly remarkable.

jyutping: gaan1 uk1 mou5 mat1 dak6 bit6。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The desk was covered with dust.

jyutping: zoeng1 toi2 pou3 mun5 zo2 can4。

author: nickyeow

english.text: We haven't had any problems so far.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zaam6 si4 zung6 mei6 jyu6 dou3 man6 tai4。

Fire!

text: 著火啦！

english.text: How have I never heard of this guy?!

jyutping: dim2 gaai2 ngo5 ho2 ji5 mou5 teng1 gwo3 ni1 go3 jan4 ge3？！
text: 點解我可以冇聽過呢個人嘅？！

author: nickyeow

english.text: You're worried. I can tell.

jyutping: nei5 hou2 daam1 sam1。ngo5 tai2 dak1 ceot1。

english.text: The bank was held up a week ago.

jyutping: gaan1 ngan4 hong4 soeng6 go3 lai5 baai3 jyu6 gip3。
text: 間銀行上個禮拜遇劫。

english.text: One is pulling a carriage; the horse enables the carriage to move - that is giving the kinetic energy to the carriage.

jyutping: jat1 zek3 maa5 laai1 gan2 gaa3 maa5 ce1；zek3 maa5 ling6 dou3 gaa3 maa5 ce1 nang4 gau3 juk1－zik1 hai6 zoeng1 dung6 nang4 bei2 zo2 gaa3 maa5 ce1。
text: 一隻馬拉緊架馬車；隻馬令到架馬車能夠郁－即係將動能俾咗架馬車。

english.text: As soon as I arrived I made an attempt to find my host, but the two or three people of whom I asked his whereabouts stared at me in such an amazed way, and denied so vehemently any knowledge of his movements, that I slunk off in the direction of the cocktail table—the only place in the garden where a single man could linger without looking purposeless and alone.

jyutping: ngo5 jat1 dou3 zau6 si3 tou4 wan2 ngo5 ge3 zyu2 jan4，daan6 hai6 ngo5 man6 keoi5 haa6 lok6 ge3 loeng5 saam1 go3 jan4 zau6 gam3 ging1 ngaa6 gam2 ding1 zyu6 ngo5，zung6 gam3 gik1 lit6 gam2 fau2 jing6 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 hang4 dung6 jau5 jam6 ho4 jing6 sik1，ngo5 zau6 tau1 tau1 dei6 zau2 zo2 jap6 heoi3 gai1 mei5 zau2 toi2 ge3 fong1 hoeng3 —— faa1 jyun4 jap6 min6 wai4 jat1 jat1 go3 ho2 ji5 ling6 dou3 jat1 go3 daan1 san1 naam4 jan4 m4 wui5 tai2 lok6 mou5 muk6 dik1 tung4 gu1 duk6 ge3 dei6 fong1。
text: 我一到就試圖搵我嘅主人，但係我問佢下落嘅兩三個人就咁驚訝噉盯住我，仲咁激烈噉否認對佢嘅行動有任何認識，我就偷偷地走咗入去雞尾酒枱嘅方向 —— 花園入面唯一一個可以令到一個單身男人唔會睇落冇目的同孤獨嘅地方。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: In the afternoon of the 17th of February of 2022, on my way to the cafe, I saw Sherie the Part-Cree by the crosswalk, as she was walking her brown pit bull. Her hair is tinted a kind of purple. We both think that purple is our favourite colour. At the cafe, I was drinking passion fruit iced tea. I saw two round-headed Himalayan-reminiscent monks in red robes with orange fleece jackets at a different table. Later, the handsome round-headed stubby man in dark clothing that I have seen several times before entered to get his coffee and speedily exited.

jyutping: hai2 2022 nin4 2 jyut6 17 hou6 ge3 haa6 zau3，ngo5 hai2 heoi3 gan2 gaa3 fe1 gun2 ge3 lou6 soeng6，hai2 jan4 haang4 waang4 dou6 bin1 gin3 dou2 bun3 hak1 lei5 jan4 syut3 lei6，keoi5 haang4 gan2 keoi5 zek3 fe1 sik1 ge3 dau3 ngau4 hyun2。keoi5 di1 tau4 faat3 jau5 di1 zi2 sik1。ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 dou1 gok3 dak1 zi2 sik1 hai6 ngo5 dei6 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 ngaan4 sik1。hai6 cafe , ngo5 jam2 gan2 jit6 cing4 gwo2 bing1 caa4。ngo5 gin3 dou2 loeng5 go3 jyun4 tau4 ge3 zang1 leoi5，zoek3 zyu6 hung4 sik1 coeng4 pou4 tung4 caang2 sik1 joeng4 mou4 ngoi6 tou3，ling6 jan4 lyun4 soeng2 dou3 hei2 maa5 laai1 ngaa5 saan1，hai2 ling6 jat1 zoeng1 toi2 dou6。hau6 loi4，ngo5 zi1 cin4 gin3 gwo3 gei2 ci3 ge3 go2 go3 zoek3 zyu6 sam1 sik1 saam1 ge3 leng3 zai2 jyun4 tau4 cou1 zong3 ge3 naam4 jan2 jap6 lai4 lo2 gaa3 fe1，jin4 hau6 hou2 faai3 zau6 lei4 hoi1 zo2。
text: 喺2022年2月17號嘅下晝，我喺去緊咖啡館嘅路上，喺人行橫道邊見到半克里人雪莉，佢行緊佢隻啡色嘅鬥牛犬。佢啲頭髮有啲紫色。我哋兩個都覺得紫色係我哋最鍾意嘅顏色。係 cafe , 我飲緊熱情果冰茶。我見到兩個圓頭嘅僧侶，着住紅色長袍同橙色羊毛外套，令人聯想到喜馬拉雅山，喺另一張枱度。後來，我之前見過幾次嘅嗰個着住深色衫嘅靚仔圓頭粗壯嘅男人入嚟攞咖啡，然後好快就離開咗。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: In the afternoon of the 16th of April of 2023, a bit of sunshine peered through the clouds after heavy rains earlier in the day. My first walk being around my neighbourhood block in the early morning, my second going to the teahouse, my third going to the pizzeria, my fourth walk out of the house led me back to the pizzeria in the afternoon to eat a cheese slice and drink Diet Cola. A new trainee was at the cashier. His name was Jadeed. I said that his name reminded me of the green gemstone "jade." A South Asian muscle man in a red shirt ate several slices in the corner. Then, I walked to the nearby grocery store to buy three bags of little green "pepitas."

jyutping: hai2 2023 nin4 4 jyut6 16 hou6 ge3 haa6 zau3，zou2 paai4 lok6 zo2 daai6 jyu5 zi1 hau6，jau5 siu2 siu2 joeng4 gwong1 tau3 gwo3 wan4 cang4 mong6 zyu6 ngo5，ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 haang4 lou6 hai6 hai2 ngo5 leon4 gan6 ge3 gaai1 fong1 fu6 gan6，ngo5 dai6 ji6 ci3 heoi3 caa4 lau4，ngo5 dai6 saam1 ci3 heoi3 bok6 beng2 pou2，ngo5 dai6 sei3 ci3 haang4 ceot1 uk1 kei2，hai2 haa6 zau3 faan1 heoi3 bok6 beng2 pou2 sik6 go3 zi1 si2 pin3，tung4 maai4 jam2 jat1 bui1 giu3 Diet new ge3 gaa3 fe1。ngo5 waa6 keoi5 go3 meng2 ling6 ngo5 nam2 hei2 luk6 sik1 ge3 bou2 sek6「juk6」。
text: 喺2023年4月16號嘅下晝，早排落咗大雨之後，有少少陽光透過雲層望住我，我第一次行路係喺我鄰近嘅街坊附近，我第二次去茶樓，我第三次去薄餅舖，我第四次行出屋企，喺下晝返去薄餅舖食個芝士片，同埋飲一杯叫 Diet new 嘅咖啡。我話佢個名令我諗起綠色嘅寶石「玉」。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: The holy books of her religion have been translated. There is loss of information, as there are wordplays, poetic rhyme, and esoteric letter numerology in the original. Also, the mindset of agrarian people thousands of years ago cannot easily be comprehended now. In some religions, adherents are required to learn the original language, so they can read their holy writings.

jyutping: keoi5 zung1 gaau3 ge3 sing3 syu1 ji5 ging1 faan1 jik6 zo2。jau5 zi1 seon3 ge3 lau4 sat1，jan1 wai6 jyun4 man4 jap6 min6 jau5 zi6 jau4 hei3、si1 wan5 tung4 sam1 ou3 ge3 zi6 mou5 sou3 hok6。tung4 maai4，gei2 cin1 nin4 cin4 ge3 nung4 jip6 jan4 ge3 sam1 taai3，ji4 gaa1 m4 jung4 ji6 lei5 gaai2。hai2 mau5 di1 zung1 gaau3 jap6 min6，seon3 tou4 jiu3 hok6 zaap6 jyun4 ci2 jyu5 jin4，gam2 keoi5 dei6 sin1 ho2 ji5 duk6 dou3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 sing3 man4。
text: 佢宗教嘅聖書已經翻譯咗。有資訊嘅流失，因為原文入面有字遊戲、詩韻同深奧嘅字母數學。同埋，幾千年前嘅農業人嘅心態，而家唔容易理解。喺某啲宗教入面，信徒要學習原始語言，噉佢哋先可以讀到佢哋嘅聖文。
